title: In-game test: Spiritbound priest + Buffy priest in one group share Prayer assignments both ways (claim, release, /reload, owner logging off)
Honour priest assignments: no card or buff-key cast for a Prayer owned by another live priest; claim/release in the options or a small panel
Port LibGroupBuffs assignment protocol v1 (hello, records, digest/repair, owner liveness) with offline tests against its message format
Buff assignments between priests, compatible with Buffy/Priestly (LibGroupBuffs protocol v1)
description:
A user runs Spiritbound next to Buffy (CurseForge 1760483, github.com/Spotnick2/Buffy, MIT) for its PallyPower-style group buffing. Buffy embeds LibGroupBuffs (github.com/Spotnick2/LibGroupBuffs, MIT, pinned tag r39), which since r37 shares raid buff assignments over addon messages. Every addon on that library (Buffy, Priestly, Wildly, Magely) sees the same assignments.

Protocol v1 (LibGroupBuffs.lua, section 'Assign', around line 5470):
- Prefix 'LibGroupBuffs' on RAID, PARTY or INSTANCE_CHAT (home group first).
- Hello: 1^H^<class>^<known spell ids csv>^<digest>. Sent on join, on entering the world, when your spells change, to answer a new peer, and every 60 s (+0-10 s jitter).
- Record: 1^A^<slot key>^<ver>^<writer>^<value>. One record per slot, the last write wins, ordered by (ver, writer, value). ver = max(server seconds x 1000, current + 1), and more than a day ahead is refused.
- Priest slots: 1243 = Prayer of Fortitude (needs 21562), 14752 = Prayer of Spirit (27681), 976 = Prayer of Shadow Protection (27683), 6346 = Fear Ward targets (key '6346:<caster>', value = csv of names). Names come from GetUnitName(unit,false). The characters ^ , : | are illegal.
- An owner counts only while live: in the group, connected, heard from within 180 s, and still able to cast the group form. Otherwise the slot is treated as unowned.
- If a digest differs, the peer schedules one repair a few seconds later that resends the missing records.
- Throttle: 10 messages, then 1 per second, and refused messages are DROPPED (result 3). Messages are cut at 255 bytes.

Goal: Spiritbound speaks the same protocol, so a Spiritbound priest and a Buffy priest share Prayer assignments:
- A buff owned by another live priest gives no card and is skipped by the buff key.
- Our own assignments show up.
- An assignment can be claimed or released from Spiritbound.
Port the protocol natively; do not embed the whole library, which ships with a UI and LibGlass. Credit the MIT copyright in THIRD_PARTY/LICENSE if code is ported. Mage and druid slots can be read and relayed but are not shown. Consider whether this belongs in LibBound, since Shadowbound and Lightbound may want it too.

title: Check in game: the buff key casts a lower rank by spell ID on a low-level member
description: LibBound 36 casts type=spell with the rank's spell ID when the target is more than 10 levels below the best rank. Check with a low-level group member that the right rank lands. Rank levels are Classic values.

title: Check the Prayer buff key in game (party, raid subgroups, candle use)
description: LibBound 34 buff key casts Prayer of Fortitude/Spirit/Shadow Protection when prayerMin (3) in a party or raid subgroup need it and the candle is in the bags. Check in game: right subgroup, range, candle used. Also: with rank 2 known and only Holy Candles it falls back to singles; casting 'Prayer of Fortitude(Rank 1)' could be added if Forever accepts rank names in /cast.

title: Buff the group: one-key Fortitude for party/raid (from Lightbound's PartyBuff)
description: The family's group features: who lacks Fortitude/Spirit/Shadow Protection, one key buffs the next. Lightbound's PartyBuff.lua is the model; belongs in LibBound when shared.
notes: The key part is done: single buffs on the group (beta 5) and the Prayers on groups/raid subgroups (LibBound 34). Still open: showing who in the group lacks a buff.
close_reason: Buff key buffs the group: single casts (beta 5) and Prayers on parties/raid subgroups (beta 6). Showing who lacks a buff is a separate wish.
